name: Zimovnica
description: 14 dana do prve ruje, pun podrum sirovine. Odlučuješ šta postaje zimovnica, šta truli. Ajvar, turšija, kiseli kupus — strategija prezimljavanja.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point, game loop, day advancement
modules.src/config.js: Sve tuning konstante: recipe costs, decay rates, fermentation timers, RNG floors
modules.src/state.js: GameState: sirovine, tegle, kasa, dani, bačva_status, rakija, forecast
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio — kuhinjski ambijent, zvek tegli, bačva KO heavy, rakija hum
modules.src/input.js: Event bus, touch/click handlers za action slot selection
modules.src/render/calendar_renderer.js: Day calendar vizualizacija, action slot prikaz
modules.src/render/hud.js: HUD komponente — countdown, kasa, storage bar
modules.src/render/shelf_renderer.js: Polica vizualizacija, tegla ikone, fermentation bubble
modules.src/ui.js: HUD: countdown, kasa, storage bar, forecast strip, toast
modules.src/entities/ingredient.js: Ingredient types, decay rates, kg tracking
modules.src/entities/recipe.js: Recipe definitions: input→output, time cost, yield formula
modules.src/entities/jar.js: Jar state: type, quantity, shelf assignment, expiry
modules.src/entities/shelf.js: Shelf capacity (base 2 police, upgradeable), placement logic
modules.src/entities/event_card.js: Event card shape: type, payload, choices, consequence
modules.src/entities/batchjob.js: Active batch: recipe, start_day, action_slots_spent, passive_timer
modules.src/entities/market.js: Market prices (tržišna cena po sirovini), trade calculation
modules.src/entities/rakija.js: Rakija entity: status, liters, unlock_day check, destilacija batch
modules.src/systems/time_system.js: Day advancement, action slot deduction, passive timer tick
modules.src/systems/fermentation.js: Fermentation progress: turšija 3–7 days, barrel state machine
modules.src/systems/barrel_init.js: Bačva KO: inicijacioni prozor (2 slots), BARREL_FAIL propagation
modules.src/systems/decay_system.js: Ingredient decay per day: paprike −2%/d, paradajz −3%/d, jabuke −1%/d
modules.src/systems/weather.js: Weather forecast: generate tomorrow, affect outdoor drying
modules.src/systems/rng_harvest.js: Berba RNG pool sa floor garantijama (paprike ≥20kg uvek)
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Unlock tracking: shelf upgrades, rakija unlock, recipes
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Prestige gate, carry-over kasa/recepti, Medenjaci check (run 2+)
modules.src/systems/event_engine.js: Daily event draw (3 per day), event resolution, BARREL_FAIL listener
modules.src/systems/trade.js: Buy/sell operations: market cena, kasa debit/credit
modules.src/content/recipes_data.js: Recipe table: ajvar, pelat, turšija, kiseli kupus, sušeno voće, džem, pekmez, sušene šljive
modules.src/content/events_data.js: Event pool: komšija, kiša, berač, tegla, mesna, pH check, Bačva KO
modules.src/content/endings_data.js: 5 endings: Imanje Prezimlelo, Dovoljno, Zima bez Rezervi, Trula Berba, Medenjaci
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Masterclass facts po receptu (MKDSLend), Guncati branding
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD, shelf-list mobile, action slots, event card, toast
modules.styles/game.css: Shelf categories, jar icons, fermentation bubble animation
